layout.buttonFallback: If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser:
layout.sentFor: This e-mail was sent to {email} on behalf of {orgName}.
layout.securityFooter: This is a security e-mail and is sent for every request on your account.

invite.subject: {inviterName} invited you to {orgName}
invite.title: {inviterName} invited you to {orgName}
invite.intro: The {orgName} team keeps its files, pages, chats and meetings in one workspace. Create your account to join the team.
invite.twoFactorNote: Your organization requires two-step verification, so you will set it up when you create your account.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation you can ignore this e-mail; no account will be created.

reset.subject: Reset your {orgName} password
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.intro: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset your password. Use the button below to choose a new one.
reset.expires: The link is valid for 30 minutes (until {time}) and works once.
reset.notMe: If you did not make this request you do not need to do anything; your password stays the same. If this keeps happening, tell your admin.
reset.sessionsNote: Changing your password signs out your open sessions. Your vault password is not affected. {orgName} never asks for your password by e-mail.

verify.subject: Verify your {orgName} e-mail address
verify.title: Verify your e-mail address
verify.intro: Hi {name}, confirm that this e-mail address belongs to you for your {orgName} account.
verify.expires: The link is valid for 24 hours.
verify.ignore: If you did not create this account you can ignore this e-mail.

smtpTest.subject: {appName} e-mail test
smtpTest.title: E-mail settings work
smtpTest.intro: This is a test e-mail sent from the setup wizard. If you can read it, invitation and password reset e-mails will arrive too.

deliveryTest.subject: {appName} notification delivery test
deliveryTest.title: E-mail delivery works
deliveryTest.intro: This is a test e-mail sent from Administration › Notification delivery. If you can read it, your organization's e-mails will arrive this way.
deliveryTest.pushBody: If you can see this, push notifications reach this device.

lock.subject: Your {orgName} account is temporarily locked
lock.title: Your account is temporarily locked
lock.intro: Hi {name}, there were {count} failed sign-in attempts in a row on your account. Sign-ins are paused for a while to keep it safe.
lock.ctaNote: Reset your password to unlock right away. Signing in with a passkey is not affected by the lock.
lock.notMe: Was this not you? Change your password and tell your admin.

lockAdmin.subject: {email} was locked
lockAdmin.title: An account was locked
lockAdmin.intro: {name} ({email}) was temporarily locked after {count} failed sign-in attempts in a row.
lockAdmin.until: The lock lifts by itself at {time}.
lockAdmin.note: If the attempts were not theirs, ask them to reset their password. You can lift the lock under Admin › Members.
